To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a database, DDPC, which integrates information about genes implicated in PC, and that it can be used to study the role of genes in PC and their potential as targets for drugs.

we developed DDPC as an integrated knowledge-base on PC, which provides pre-compiled information on molecular interactions, gene regulation at the molecular level, predicted TF binding sites and transcription factors corresponding to these binding sites, and DrugBank data on PC associated drugs.

(i) we developed an integrated knowledgebase, Dragon Database of Genomes associated with Prostate cancer, which provides pre-compiled text mining information on genes implicated in prostate cancer, (ii) the database contains information on molecular interactions, gene ontologies and pathways of these genes and (iii) we have integrated data from DrugBank on drugs associated with prostate cancer.
